name: Gemcitabine (single agent)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT single-agent option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Low emetogenic; give per emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: Myelosuppression is the main dose-limiting toxicity; hold day 8 for low counts.
Watch for transient flu-like symptoms and, rarely, pulmonary or hemolytic-uremic toxicity.
monitoring: CBC on days 1 and 8 of each cycle

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 8 every 21 days as a single agent for recurrent ovarian cancer; may be combined with carboplatin (platinum-sensitive) or bevacizumab. Hold day 8 or reduce for cytopenias per package insert. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
